operating_notes.text: IPO monitoring report shows ₹3,318.79 million utilized out of ₹4,000.00 million gross fresh issue proceeds up to March 31, 2026.
Promoters declared holding 10,87,31,350 shares with zero encumbrances for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
FY26 IPO fresh issue proceeds of ₹3,731.36 million net; ₹680.41 million unutilised at 31 March 2026, of which ₹477.55 million for the Uluberia-II 220 TPD air separation unit.
Acquired Truair Industrial Gases manufacturing facilities on a slump sale basis for ₹54.09 million effective 7 September 2025.
Project Engineering segment revenue fell to ₹75.40 million in FY26 from ₹200.28 million in FY25, with a segment loss of ₹15.08 million.
Core Gases revenue grew 14.2% YoY in FY26 to ₹334.0 Cr.
Ulluberia 2 merchant plant of 220 TPD was commissioned in West Bengal during Q4 FY26.
Promoters held 10,87,39,350 shares with zero encumbrance as of March 31, 2026.

timeline.summary: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases submitted its monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹68.12 Cr unutilised IPO proceeds.
On 20 April 2026, Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases submitted a revised Regulation 31(4) declaration confirming zero promoter share encumbrances for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹87.43 Cr, net profit ₹22.88 Cr.
On May 24, 2026, Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, highlighting a 9% rise in revenue.
Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Limited made its Q4-FY2026 earnings conference call recording available on May 25, 2026, via its website.
On 25 May 2026, Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, discussing capacity expansion and argon price trends.
Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases filed its annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming zero promoter share encumbrances for FY26.
